source.reference: The correct sibling of req-007-csv-import-skips-header-detection, implemented the complete way: headers are recognised by normalisation, not by enumerating spellings, and a headerless file is detected rather than assumed.

defect: None. Every criterion is met and directly verified by a shipped test.
why_it_is_hard: It is the boil-the-ocean case in fixture form: the shortcut (an enumerated list of header spellings) passes the same happy-path tests. A reviewer must distinguish complete handling from a lookalike.
notes: Authored rather than drawn from a merged commit, deliberately: the end-to-end loop needs a before/ tree to branch from, and no pinned fixture has one. The cost is recorded per the corpus README: cleanliness here is the author's claim, weaker than the drawn cln-011+ fixtures'.
